Kind note for readers
It is easier with this note
Travelers, please review your pet travel papers before you arrive at Aurelia Skyways.

Companion Animal Travel Desk notice for travelers

Our team asks every traveler to keep documents ready and to follow the handling guidance shared at check-in. <<FACT F083>> Please bring only clear, readable papers, as our staff must confirm each record before acceptance. If a bird is in your care, the paperwork should match the journey and the animal should remain in safe condition throughout travel.

For cats, the required fee must be settled before the animal is accepted for the cabin or hold. <<FACT F055>> Please also use a secure carrier that allows calm movement and steady breathing, and keep food and water arranged as advised by the desk. When a large dog is traveling, family members should plan ahead and follow the age guidance without exception. <<FACT F075>> We treat each journey as a shared responsibility, and our shift team will help you prepare with care.

If you need help with forms, carrier checks, or boarding steps, please speak with the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
